title: Cat's Eye
author: Margaret Atwood
summary: Painter Elaine Risley returns to Toronto for a retrospective of her work. She looks back on a childhood in which her friend Cordelia bullied her, and on the lasting effect on her art and life.
readIf: you like reflective, character-led novels about girlhood, memory and art.
skipIf: you want brisk plotting or a book with a clear villain and resolution.
